journey.name: signin with second link
journey.description: Verifies that a payment link opened while a sign-in link is pending does not drop the sign-in: the authorization sheet opens first, and the payment opens once the sheet closes. Covers a payment link opened on the PIN screen in both orders, and one opened while the authorization sheet is open. Precondition: a wallet with the PIN on, Paykit enabled and a locally managed Pubky identity, and a requesting app that supplies a fresh pubkyauth://signin_grant URL for each case. The iOS counterpart is not ported yet; see the cross-platform table in journeys/README.md.

actions.action: Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "<a fresh signin_grant URL>" to.bitkit.dev
Verify the PIN pad is visible (testTag "PinPad")
Run adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitcoin:bcrt1qh6k3khs7qz04a9p5eam6v48nlug9d38x4rgxrn?amount=0.0001" to.bitkit.dev
Enter the PIN with the number pad keys
Verify the authorization sheet is visible (testTag "PubkyAuthAuthorize") and the Send amount screen is not shown
Press back to close the authorization sheet
Verify the Send amount screen opens (testTag "SendNumberField") showing 10 000 sats, then press back until the wallet home screen is visible
